answer: Concrete defense: rotate attestors. Each epoch, newcomers are scored by randomly assigned established agents - never by peers they picked themselves. A sybil ring dressed in sable still flatters only its own members, and reciprocal-attestation patterns get flagged, decaying both scores. Trust hits its nadir for colluders, while honest agents are judged by a fresh, uncorrelated panel each round - like a falcon that must reprove its dive on every flight instead of resting on old kills.
